description: MTN2 NDN theme — embedded default (RCDATA THEME_DEFAULT) and the shape of the on-disk override at the config dir (uColorCoding.GetConfigFilePath — active file name set by TMtnSession.ThemeFile, 'NDNtheme.json' when unspecified). Currently only 'fileColoring' (FAR Manager 'File highlighting' style): groups are checked top to bottom against the file/folder display name, first mask match wins. Each group can set colors for up to three visual states — 'normal' (plain row), 'selected' (marked), 'current' (under the cursor) — as optional #RRGGBB 'fg'/'bg' pairs; a state a group doesn't set is left to the theme's own per-filetype/selection/cursor color. Colors here are theme-owned on purpose — picked to not clash with THIS theme's own selection/cursor palette (e.g. Archives is magenta, not yellow, because yellow reads as the NDN selection color) — so a different theme file (e.g. FARtheme.json) is expected to repick them for its own palette rather than share this file. An on-disk override only needs the groups it wants to add or change (uColorCoding.MergeColorCodingGroups, merge-by-name); the extreme case is a file that redefines every group, which amounts to a full replacement.
